goal.statement: Reduce the waiting blocker count by giving the Owner one decision packet that covers the Codex CLI install and the RUN-003 push together.
goal.rationale: waiting_blockers is 6 against a target of 0 with tolerance 2, which activated Owner alignment at 0.95; a single bounded packet is the smallest reversible action that can lower it.

desire.name: owner_alignment
desire.description: Keep the Owner informed, in control and unsurprised.

arguments.argument: One packet with measured facts, a pinned version, a cost line and a rollback lets the Owner decide in one pass instead of four.
Bundling an install with a push risks one refusal blocking both; they are separable decisions.
No external effect happens until approval, and both items are reversible by uninstall or branch reset.
Install is 0 KRW and the packet excludes billable provider prompts, which stay a separate approval.

verdict.reason: The Owner is time-limited (about 5 hours per week), so one packet with two clearly separated decisions costs less Owner attention than two packets.
verdict.dissent: SKEPTIC: a single refusal could stall both items; each decision is therefore answerable on its own.
